stories.title: Keystone Group acquires BMO Tower in downtown Indianapolis
stories.summary: The tower is located at 135 North Pennsylvania Street, near Monument Circle.

stories.title: 1 dead, 2 critically hurt in crash on southeast side of Indianapolis
stories.summary: According to IMPD, the crash happened just before 10:30 a.m. at South Emerson Avenue and Shelbyville Road.

stories.title: Carmel man charged with murder in fatal shooting of his wife
stories.summary: Carmel police said officers were called to a home in the 13900 block of Wildcat Drive shortly before 10:30 p.m. Nov. 12 on a report of shots fired.

stories.title: Indy airport expects 164,000 Thanksgiving travelers as Shapiro's closes for remodel
stories.summary: Airport officials are expecting roughly 164,000 travelers to fly out of Indianapolis between Nov. 20 and Nov. 29.

stories.title: Indianapolis man convicted of murder in 2024 hit-and-run in bar parking lot
stories.summary: Felipe Maguellal was found guilty of killing 40-year-old Perry Banks with his SUV outside a bar on West Morris Street on Oct. 19, 2024.

stories.title: Exclusive: ACLU of Indiana names new interim legal director as internal investigation continues
stories.summary: Lauren Robel will oversee the ACLU's legal work to protect rights for Hoosiers after staff shakeup.

stories.title: 1 killed, 2 seriously injured in 5-car crash in rural Tippecanoe County
stories.summary: The crash was reported around 4 p.m. Nov. 17 along southbound US Highway 231 around 15 miles south of Lafayette.

stories.title: Person in critical condition after shooting on Indy's near east side
stories.summary: The shooting happened around 12:20 a.m. Wednesday, near the intersection of Dorman and East New York streets.

stories.title: 27-year-old man dead after being shot on near north side of Indianapolis
stories.summary: The shooting happened around 11:45 p.m. Tuesday, near North Meridian and 34th streets.

stories.title: Around 500 birds found on property searched by Indiana Gaming Commission, Jasper County Sheriff's Department to be euthanized
stories.summary: The Indiana Gaming Commission and Jasper County Sheriff's Department collaborated to carry out a search-warrant at a property for gamebird fighting.

stories.title: Statewide Silver Alert canceled for missing 84-year-old man from Michigan
stories.summary: The man was last seen Monday, Nov. 16 and was missing from Macomb Township, Michigan.

stories.title: Silver Alert canceled for woman missing from Munster
stories.summary: State police canceled a Silver Alert for a 71-year-old woman who was reported missing from Lake County Tuesday.
